title: Police Respond To Stripper Issue
description:
While on routine patrol, an officer was flagged down by the owner of Bambi's Dollhouse stating that one of his dancers was breaking mirrors in a rage. The officer was escorted into the changing area and observed a very large mirror shattered and an enraged female who wouldn’t stop arguing. The officer gave the female an opportunity to dress herself but when he placed her in cuffs, she began resisting violently. The 5 foot tall female had relatively smaller arms and she somehow managed to get one of her hands out of the cuffs and continued to resist until the cuffs were put on again and tightened on her wrist. During the tense confrontation, the officer sustained a bite mark to his neck. The 23 year old female was charged with battery on a law enforcement officer and resisting arrest.
